g.text: bin/sciebo help

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: Usage: sciebo <command> [options]

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: Sync local directories with a sciebo (Nextcloud/WebDAV) remote via rclone.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: Transfers and deletions happen only through `sync` and `cleanup --apply`.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: Commands:

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: setup create/update the sciebo rclone remote

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: doctor [--offline] preflight checks (PASS/WARN/FAIL report)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: discover [--write] find git repositories under roots.conf

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: list list configured sources (mode, name, paths, filter)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: check dry run of all sources (no changes)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: sync [options] apply sync/pull/bisync for all sources

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: verify [options] check that sources match their destinations

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: status [options] last run per source, plus the pause state

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: pause [--for DURATION] skip sync/check runs until resumed

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: resume clear the pause marker

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: folders <subcommand> choose/add/list/remove folder pairs

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: mount [options] mount the remote on demand (nfsmount)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: umount <selector> unmount a recorded mount

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: mounts [--folder SUB] show recorded mounts

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: cleanup [options] old logs / stale chunk-upload housekeeping

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: schedule <subcommand> install/uninstall/status of the launchd agent

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: trash [subcommand] list/restore/remove/empty the Nextcloud trashbin

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: versions SUB [options] list/download/restore/delete file versions

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: share <subcommand> create, list, update, or remove Nextcloud shares

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: notifications list or delete Nextcloud notifications

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: activity show the Nextcloud activity stream

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: presence [set ...] show or set your Nextcloud user status

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: lock SUB / unlock SUB lock or unlock a remote file (WebDAV)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: locks [options] list locks recorded by `sciebo lock`

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: quota show server quota usage

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: open [SUB] open a local sync folder

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: conflicts [options] find local conflict copies

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: retry [NAME [PATH]] clear failure-blacklist entries

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: account <subcommand> manage profiles (list/add/remove/use)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: logout [--yes] remove credentials for the active remote

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: Global options (before the command): --profile NAME, --trust,

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: --non-interactive, --debug, --log-file FILE.

g.text: Run `sciebo help <command>` or `<command> --help` for command options.
